name: assistant
title: Assistant
description: Talk to your brain: ask questions, find capabilities and open what you need.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the assistant surface; input "docked" composes it for the working area without opening a window.

operations.name: send
operations.description: Start a turn in the current conversation with this message; the transcript neuron shows the answer.

operations.name: new
operations.description: Start a new conversation; the conversation neuron holds its id.

operations.name: voice
operations.description: Begin a voice message from the dock; the composer neuron captures and transcribes it.

settings.name: Model
settings.description: Model catalog id; empty uses the deployment default.

settings.name: RouteGate
settings.description: Confidence (0-1) above which Jev answers a request directly, without the language model.
